name: UEFA Financial Fair Play settlement
outcome: Settled in May 2014 with no findings made.

name: UEFA Financial Fair Play case and CAS appeal
body: UEFA Club Financial Control Body; Court of Arbitration for Sport
outcome: Two-season ban overturned by CAS in July 2020; fine cut to €10 million for failing to cooperate.

name: Premier League v Manchester City
outcome: Charges found proven in September 2026, bar Charge 4(B). Sanction not yet decided. City denies wrongdoing and has said it will appeal.

name: Associated Party Transaction rules arbitration
outcome: Previous rules ruled unenforceable; settled in September 2025 with City accepting the current rules as valid.
